authority.precedence: This file freezes P1 operational choices without changing the attached instructions or experiment contract.

pilot_unit.reason_selected_before_p1_outcomes: one legal development unit with an existing strict-nested panel and patient-grouped lineage

scope.pilot_stop: Run exactly the frozen pilot unit, write and audit its artifacts, then stop. Do not launch any other unit until an independent audit and explicit root instruction.

p0_hash_manifest.rule: Every complete-run source panel, generation record, archived prediction, selection record, and head record must match its file-level SHA-256 in this P0 manifest before use.

cbis_development_cohort.role: development-only complete-case concept labels, validity masks, case identifiers, patient groups, and original patient folds used to reconstruct probe-fit priors

data_roles.E: outer-development evaluation rows, never used for fitting or selecting any component
data_roles.H: one diagnosis-inner validation block inside T
data_roles.G: one deeper probe-validation block inside D

arms.R: reference diagnostic head fit on annotated concept inputs in T and evaluated on annotated concept inputs in E
arms.S: the same final reference head evaluated by direct substitution of raw predicted soft scores in E
arms.C: positive-slope affine calibration of the final reference-head logits produced from raw predicted soft scores
arms.M: diagnostic head selected and fit on full-chain out-of-fold raw predicted soft scores in T, then evaluated on raw predicted soft scores in E
arms.SP: the same final reference head evaluated by direct substitution of fit-local-prior-restored predicted soft scores in E
arms.CP: positive-slope affine calibration of the final reference-head logits produced from fit-local-prior-restored predicted soft scores
arms.MP: diagnostic head selected and fit on full-chain out-of-fold fit-local-prior-restored predicted soft scores in T, then evaluated on fit-local-prior-restored predicted soft scores in E

arm_separation: R, S, C, M, SP, CP, and MP are separate evaluation arms. No predictions or parameters are fused across arms.

concept_score_rules.numerical_rule: Within each concept block, form an unnormalised state vector r_k=max(q_k,eps)*pi_k and normalise r/sum(r). For a CBIS binary concept, the source state vector is [1-q,q] before max(.,eps), so q_prior is the normalised positive-state component. Do not clip pi, and do not first clip a scalar q to [eps,1-eps]. A zero empirical-prior state therefore remains exactly zero. Fail closed if sum(r) is non-finite or non-positive.
concept_score_rules.binary_formula: q_prior = pi1*max(q,eps) / (pi0*max(1-q,eps) + pi1*max(q,eps)), where pi0 and pi1 are separately normalised empirical state frequencies on concept-valid probe-fit rows
concept_score_rules.multiclass_formula: q_prior[k] = pi[k]*max(q[k],eps) / sum_j(pi[j]*max(q[j],eps)) within each concept block
concept_score_rules.prior_source: For every predicted row and concept block, pi is the empirical concept-state prior from the exact rows used to fit the concept predictor that generated that row's q.
forbidden_prior_sources: diagnosis-inner validation H for a predictor fit on D
deeper probe-validation G for a predictor fit on D minus G
concept_score_rules.cbis_reconstruction: For each concept separately, use only concept_valid rows among the exact original patient-fold probe-fit rows; compute pi0=n0/(n0+n1) and pi1=n1/(n0+n1). Verify n0, n1, fit-row count, patient count, and SHA-256 of the ordered valid-fit unit identifiers against the corresponding frozen generation-manifest concept_fits record. The complete-case archive is expected to be all-valid, but this must be checked rather than assumed.
concept_score_rules.derm_reconstruction: For each categorical concept block, compute the empirical frequency of every state on the exact seeded strict_meta or strict_meta_inner probe-fit rows, preserving the frozen block cardinality. States absent from the fit rows have prior zero and remain exactly zero after restoration.

score_role_prior_provenance.z_H_and_raw_T_block_H: pi(D), because the concept predictor generating z_H was fit on D=T\H; raw_T is the row-wise stitch of these z_H blocks
score_role_prior_provenance.x_G_inside_D: pi(D\G), because the deeper concept predictor generating x_G was fit on D\G
score_role_prior_provenance.val_E: pi(T), because the final concept predictor generating the outer-evaluation score was fit on T

diagnostic_head.selection_target: unweighted mean of diagnosis-inner-fold class-equal NLL
diagnostic_head.tie_break: first minimum in ascending C grid
diagnostic_head.reference_head_selection: For each H-specific calibration reference head, select C wholly inside D=T\H: for every G in the frozen partition of D, fit on annotated concepts in D\G, validate on annotated concepts in G, average class-equal NLL across G, choose the first minimum in the ascending grid, then fit on annotated concepts in D. For the outer-final reference head, for every H fit on annotated concepts in D and validate on annotated concepts in H, average across H, choose C, then fit on annotated concepts in T.
diagnostic_head.matching_head_selection: M follows the frozen original protocol. For every candidate C and H, fit on x_D, whose rows are deeper G-out-of-fold raw predicted scores over D, validate on raw z_H, and average class-equal NLL across H; fit the selected head on raw_T and evaluate on val_E. MP is isomorphic, replacing x_D, z_H, raw_T, and val_E row by row with their fit-local-prior-restored versions.

calibration_base_scores: For each H inside T, define D=T\H.
Use the frozen z_H=q_H generated by a concept predictor fit on D; E and H were absent from that predictor fit.
Select an H-specific reference diagnostic-head C wholly inside D using annotated concepts: for each G, fit on D\G and validate on G; then average across G and choose the first minimum.

Fit that H-specific selected reference head on annotated concepts in D and call decision_function on q_H to obtain an out-of-fold reference logit. For CP, call the same head on the pi(D)-restored q_H. The C and CP calibration vectors are distinct and are fitted separately.

Stitch the H-specific logits for all H to form exactly one full-chain out-of-fold calibration row per T case. The outer-final reference head is forbidden for generating these calibration-training logits.
matching_training_scores: For each H, predicted z_H comes from a concept predictor fit on D=T\H.

For every matching-head candidate C within each H, fit on x_D, in which every row in deeper block G was scored by a concept predictor fit on D\G, and validate on z_H; average validation class-equal NLL across H.
Raw matching uses q; prior-restored matching uses q_prior computed from the exact corresponding concept-predictor fit rows.
After C selection, M fits on raw_T and MP fits on the identically ordered restored raw_T; both evaluate the identically ordered val_E representation assigned to their arm.
No E row or outcome enters concept prediction, head selection, calibration, or final head fitting.
full_chain_oof.cbis_partition: The four original patient folds remaining after the outer fold define H; the other three original patient folds inside D define G.
full_chain_oof.derm_partition: The seeded four-way strict_meta split defines H. Within each D, reconstruct exactly four G folds with case_kfold_splits(len(D),4,_seed(cfg.seed,'strict_meta_inner',rep,outer_fold,h,'split')) and map local indices back to global development rows without reordering.
full_chain_oof.outer_final_reference_head: Select C by the four H gold-input fits D->H, fit on annotated concepts in T, and use this one fitted head for R, S, SP and for the outer-E base logits transformed by C and CP.
full_chain_oof.required_case_level_lineage: Record fit and validation row counts, case/group hashes, and disjointness assertions for every H and G relation.

affine_calibration.z_ref: reference diagnostic-head logit evaluated on predicted concept inputs
affine_calibration.fit_target: class-equal binary NLL on stitched full-chain OOF rows in T
affine_calibration.objective: eta_i=a*z_i+b; w_i=1/(2*n_{y_i}); J(a,b)=sum_i w_i*(logaddexp(0,eta_i)-y_i*eta_i). The analytic gradient is [sum_i w_i*(sigmoid(eta_i)-y_i)*z_i, sum_i w_i*(sigmoid(eta_i)-y_i)].
affine_calibration.fallback: none; any optimizer failure, non-finite value, bound violation, identity-objective increase beyond tolerance, or KKT failure aborts the unit without publishing COMPLETE
affine_calibration.kkt_rule: At the solution, abs(gradient_b)<=1e-5. If a>1e-6+1e-10, abs(gradient_a)<=1e-5; at the lower bound, gradient_a>=-1e-5.
affine_calibration.separate_fits: C and CP use separately fitted affine calibrators.
audits: fitted objective is no greater than the identity-map objective within numerical tolerance
first-order or active-bound condition is satisfied within declared tolerance
within each outer unit separately, C and S have identical rank order and AUC within 1e-12, and CP and SP have identical rank order and AUC within 1e-12; no globally stitched invariance claim is used

contrasts.auc_reporting: For every named X_minus_Y contrast, additionally report AUC(X)-AUC(Y); positive favours X and negative favours Y. Never label C_minus_M NLL as a gain without this direction.

uncertainty.cbis_cluster: patient with all associated rows retained
uncertainty.derm_cluster: case with all repetitions retained together
uncertainty.paired_draws: Use the identical sampled cluster multiset for every arm and every contrast within a domain and draw.
uncertainty.nll_complete_run_estimator: Compute each case-arm negative-log-likelihood contribution within repetition, average repeated contributions for the same case across repetitions first, then resample whole patient clusters for CBIS or whole cases for Derm. Recompute class-equal NLL from the resampled case-first table.
uncertainty.auc_complete_run_estimator: Within every bootstrap draw, compute AUC separately in every repetition from the sampled clusters/cases, then take the unweighted mean across repetitions.
uncertainty.interval: two-sided percentile 95% interval using empirical 0.025 and 0.975 quantiles of all 10000 paired draws
uncertainty.missing_class_draw_rule: A draw missing either outcome class in any required repetition is rejected and redrawn from the same seeded RNG until 10000 valid paired draws are obtained; abort if 100000 total proposals do not yield 10000 valid draws.
uncertainty.pilot: descriptive point estimates and per-case paired contributions only; no inferential interval is claimed from one outer unit

resource_thresholds.interpretation: descriptive resource-relevance thresholds, not significance thresholds and not decision rules for expanding the search

pilot.interpretation: Engineering and audit pilot only. These artifacts are not a P1 scientific conclusion, do not trigger hypothesis acceptance or rejection, and cannot be used to alter this frozen contract.

schemas.selections.json: Per-fold loss curves in ascending C-grid order, selected indices/C values, fit/validation scope hashes, and tie-break audit for outer reference, every H-specific reference, M, and MP.
schemas.calibrators.json: Separate C and CP optimizer inputs, selected parameters, objective/gradient/KKT diagnostics, iteration/status fields, and identity comparison.
schemas.prior_lineage.json: One record per domain/unit/score-role/H/G/concept-block with source fit indices and ordered case/group scope hashes, empirical counts/prior, matching frozen generating-probe manifest record, and exact-match assertions.
schemas.lineage.json: T/E/H/D/G membership hashes, partitions, disjointness, source paths/hashes, software versions, and arm row-alignment assertions.
schemas.audit.json: Every mandatory audit as a named boolean with observed values/tolerances; publishing requires all true.
schemas.fit_cost.json: Wall time and per-component counts/times for probe reuse, head fits, selections, prior restoration, affine fits, metrics, audits, and output writing.
schemas.execution_manifest.json: Protocol/runner/source hashes plus byte size and SHA-256 for every published artifact except COMPLETE.json.
schemas.COMPLETE.json: Written last in staging; records unit identity, status COMPLETE, protocol SHA-256, execution-manifest SHA-256, and completion timestamp.

output_contract.atomic_publication: Write to a new unit-local staging directory; fail if final target exists; write COMPLETE.json last only after every audit passes; atomically rename the whole staging directory to the final unit path. A directory lacking a valid COMPLETE.json is incomplete and must never enter aggregation.

mandatory_audits: input hashes equal this protocol
every used complete-run source file equals its file-level hash in P0_HASH_MANIFEST.json
pilot invocation exactly equals cbis repetition 0 outer fold 0
the H blocks partition T exactly once with no missing or duplicate row or group leakage
within every H, the G blocks partition D exactly once with no missing or duplicate row or group leakage
all E rows are excluded from every fit and selection relation
all H rows are excluded from the concept predictor and reference head that generate their calibration base logits
all G rows are excluded from their generating concept predictor fit
patient groups are disjoint wherever CBIS rows are held out
for every q role and concept block, the prior fit-scope hash exactly equals the fit-scope hash of the frozen probe that generated q
every fit-local prior equals an independently recomputed empirical prior from the recorded probe-fit rows
the C calibration OOF vector and the CP calibration OOF vector each contain every T row exactly once in the original T order

the final C outer-evaluation base logits exactly equal the S reference-head logits before affine transformation, and the final CP outer-evaluation base logits exactly equal the SP reference-head logits before affine transformation
all seven arms have identical case_id, group_id, y, and row order
all seven arms contain exactly one finite probability per outer evaluation row
R, S, and M reproduce their archived strict-nested pilot predictions within declared numerical tolerance
M selected C reproduces the archived strict-nested pilot choice
C and CP satisfy the positive-slope calibration audits
no bootstrap or non-pilot unit is run in pilot mode
execution_manifest covers every artifact and COMPLETE.json is created last before one atomic directory publication
